code_paths.note: Analyst script kept verbatim as stlray.py; thin bridge/file adapters import it. Research copies in tools/.

connection_authentication.algorithm: HMAC-SHA256 (layer-key derivation + TVC KDF/mask/AAD) and ECDSA P-256 (catalog signature). Both are local format integrity / key derivation, NOT VPN connection authentication.
connection_authentication.note: No HMAC or MAC was observed authorizing a VPN connection. Server credentials in the catalog are username/password/UUID/auth_str for VLESS, SSH, OpenVPN and Hysteria1; no connection-auth handshake was traced or attempted. Status covers the reviewed material only.
connection_authentication.scope: formato de catalogo y de archivo/enlace

inputs.origin: round-trip over a real profile taken from the live catalog (server CELCOM BASIC 01); no real exported file or link supplied

limitations: No real exported .sray file or STLRAY link has been supplied: the TVC file/text codec is VERIFIED_SYNTHETIC (encode/decode round-trip over a real catalog profile, normal + locked + all 8 keyed schemes + hyb://).
.ovpn, sing-box JSON and subscription imports go through the native libstlraytcore.so core (libbox ProfileDecoder.Decode, first byte 0x01) and are NOT covered by this Python decoder.
The secondary VpnGate source (http://www.vpngate.net/api/iphone/) is a public relay list, NOT part of the STLRAY catalog, and is not integrated.
The catalog updates block (download API / locator) is stripped from the bridge result by design (Pedro's rule); it is never part of the delivered catalog JSON.
network_requirements: live catalog fetch only (broker, plain GET); decoders run offline.
